gpio_numbers: GPIO identifiers, not physical header positions

rules.blocked: Never expose or drive these GPIO identifiers; includes SPI flash pins and unavailable GPIO numbers.
rules.console: Reserved for the USB serial console; no application GPIO operations.
rules.input_only: Only plain digital input is allowed; output and internal pull-up/pull-down modes are unavailable.
rules.strapping: Use requires explicit confirmation; GPIO12 must be held low during boot.
rules.adc1: ADC1 remains available while Wi-Fi is active.
rules.adc2: ADC2 is unavailable while Wi-Fi is active.
rules.dac: DAC output is supported only on GPIO25 and GPIO26.
rules.general: General digital input/output and PWM capability, subject to other class restrictions.

verification.notes: Profile classifies GPIO identifiers. Verify actual 38-pin board silkscreen/header mapping against the owner's board before relying on physical header positions.
